name: Nagafen's Island
note: Mythic Lord Nagafen's raid (work board 2429; entity/mythicnagafen.go, handlers/heroicraids.go; claude-notes/mythic-nagafen-20261127.md): Lavastorm's own cell (2, 2), the disc's LAVASTM.ESF zone record 0 (the npcs rows' zone 28 is the cell's number on Lavastorm's 13-wide grid; the file holds two zone records), served in a world of its own because Permafrost holds Tunaria's cell (2, 2) in world 14. The island is a dry triangle (x 4776-4904, z 4318-4440, y -28 to -29.5) in a ring of walkable lava (Heirloom's lava burns 49% of the most hit points every 3 s) under cliffs. Every party that goes in fights in a copy of its own, entered only at the Heroic Raids NPC by Tunaria's north-west mountains. The dungeons block is read by the server, never written into the file. Built by cmd/worldbuild from the operator's disc.
